facts.statement: Seven is a rummy-style card game
facts.sourceSentence: Seven is a rummy-style card game for 1 to 7 players that plays in about 7 minutes, and is recommended for ages 7 and up.

facts.statement: A game plays in about 7 minutes
The game is recommended for ages 7 and up
Each player is given a Ways to Score card during setup
facts.sourceSentence: Give each player a "Ways to Score" card.

facts.statement: A pile of face-down cards is created in the center of the table and mixed
facts.sourceSentence: Create a mess of face-down cards in the middle of the table and mixes them around.

facts.statement: Each player draws 3 cards from the central pile initially to form their starting hand
facts.sourceSentence: Each player should then draw 3 cards from the mess to form their hand.

facts.statement: Round actions are simultaneous among all players
Each player draws 2 cards during each round
facts.sourceSentence: Each player draws 2 cards into their hand.

facts.statement: Each player discards 1 card face-up to their personal discard pile during each round
facts.sourceSentence: Each player discards 1 card from their hand face-up off to the side of the table in their own discard pile.

facts.statement: Each player will have 7 discards when the game ends
facts.sourceSentence: you will have 7 discards when the game is over.

facts.statement: The game ends when all players have 10 cards
facts.sourceSentence: If everyone has 10 cards, end the game; otherwise begin the next round.

facts.statement: Each player scores using their best 7-card hand, with bonus point cards added to the score
facts.sourceSentence: Each player scores their best hand of 7 cards, and adds any bonus point cards (even beyond the hand of 7) to their score.

facts.statement: Each player's cumulative score should be tracked across all games in the match
facts.sourceSentence: Play 7 games and keep track of each player's score total.

facts.statement: The player with the highest cumulative score at the end of the match wins
facts.sourceSentence: Whichever player has the highest total score at the end of the match wins!

facts.statement: Matches can be played as a best of 3 series as an alternative format
facts.sourceSentence: if you would like a shorter or longer match, feel free to play a match as a best of 3 games or a best of 10 games.

facts.statement: Matches can be played as a best of 10 series as an alternative format
facts.sourceSentence: if you would like a shorter or longer match, feel free to play a match as a best of 3 games or a best of 10 games.
